138591.name: Aces Bar
138591.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance, and level access throughout the venue.

The accessible toilets are located past the bar and down the hallway.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show, including tall stools/chairs, booth seating and standing room.

There is a public carpark by Care Park across the road from the venue.

138462.name: Alexander Theatre
138462.address: The Ian Potter Centre for Performing Arts, 48 Exhibition Walk, Monash University
138462.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access into the ground floor foyer from both sides of the building. The box office, bar, and accessible toilets are located in the foyer.

There is a hearing loop system that covers the entire venue auditorium via a T-switch.

There is fixed raked seating during the show and up to 10 wheelchairs can be accommodated per performance. Wheelchair spaces are located at entry gallery level and in the back row of the performance space. There is lift access from the foyer to both areas of the audience.

The Monash University S2 underground carpark is located at the front of the venue and is available from 5pm. It includes 8 accessible parking spaces adjacent to the lift on the upper section of Level 1. The lift exits the carpark approx 250m from the venue entrance.

For more information, please contact the venue directly by email or by calling 03 9905 1111.

139234.name: Anglers Tavern
139234.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are in the carpark outside the venue.

54630.name: Arbory Bar & Eatery
54630.accessibilityDetails:
The east entrance of the venue has unassisted wheelchair access and there is an accessible toilet a few metres from the performance space.

There is level unfixed/flexible seating during the show.

17888.name: Askal
17888.accessibilityDetails:
There are 20 steps to reach the performance space and no wheelchair access. There is unfixed level seating during the show.

The accessible bathrooms are located outside the performance space.

Accessible parking is available outside the venue.

139475.name: Balam Balam Place
139475.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue. The accessible bathrooms are located on the ground floor.

There is a mix of unfixed/flexible level seating, or standing room, depending on the show.

There are three accessible parking bays on Phoenix St approx. 50m from the venue entrance.

139472.name: Ballarat Performing Arts Centre - The Chapel
139472.accessibilityDetails:
Wheelchair access is available via an alternative entrance. The accessible toilets are located at the rear of the venue.

There is fixed raked seating during the show.

There is on street parking approx. 20m from the venue.

16986.name: Ballers Clubhouse
16986.accessibilityDetails:
There are three steps at the front entrance. A ramp can be placed over steps for wheelchair access. Once inside the venue there is step free access to all performance spaces via a lift.

There are accessible toilets on all levels of the venue. There is unfixed flexible seating during the show.

The nearest parking is Wilsons Car Park located at 180 Russell St.

17887.name: Bar 1806
17887.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access through the main entrance and 20 steps from there down to the performance space. There is no wheelchair access.

There is unfixed level seating during the show.

On-street parking is available nearby.

17812.name: Bar Open
17812.accessibilityDetails:
There is one step into the bar and a further 20 stairs to the upstairs performance space. There is no wheelchair access.

There is a mix of level seating during the show, including cabaret seating with tables and standing room.

Accessible parking bays are available on Brunswick Street.

3237.name: Bard's Apothecary
3237.accessibilityDetails:
There are 3 steps to enter the venue, as well as a flight of 16 stairs descending into the basement level performance space. There is no lift access.

There are no accessible bathrooms; they are located in the basement which is down a flight of stairs. There is level unfixed seating, including a mix of couches, stools and taller chairs.

There is an accessible parking space on the corner of Bourke St and Liverpool St, as well as two accessible parking spaces on the corner of Spring St and Little Bourke St. Other parking can be found in the parking garage on Bourke St.

17313.name: Brewmanity
17313.accessibilityDetails:
There is wheelchair access into the venue, but venue staff will need to be notified beforehand. 

The accessible bathrooms are on the ground floor next to the stage. There is unfixed level seating during the show.

Accessible parking bays are approx 20m away.

17016.name: Bunjil Place
17016.accessibilityDetails:
The Plaza, Theatre and Studio areas are fully wheelchair accessible with ramps and seating options. There is an accessible adult change room complete with hoist, shower and seat, toilet rails and a lowered sink, as well as an accessible gender-neutral bathroom off the ground floor foyer.

The Theatre operates via the hearing/induction loop to broadcast audio to cochlear implants, telecoil (t-coil) or loop receivers. These can be collected on arrival at the Box Office desk.

Braille is provided on all room door signage and fixed directional signage.

There are two accessible parking bays on Patrick Northeast Drive, opposite the venue.

For more information, please contact the venue directly on 03 9709 9700.

137865.name: Captain Melville - MC Comedy Hub
137865.accessibilityDetails:
There are 15-20 steps into the venue and no alternative wheelchair accessible entrance.

There is unfixed level seating during the show.

3280.name: Cardinia Cultural Centre
3280.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access through the venue's main entrance, and the theatre is located directly to your right. The accessible bathrooms are found off the main foyer.

There are communication boards at the box office, and fixed raked seating during the show.

There are four accessible parking bays located approx 75m from the main entrance, as well as two accessible parking bays approx 35m from the gallery entrance.

For more information, please visit the venue's accessibility page or call on 1300 887 624.

17344.name: Caz Reitop's Dirty Secrets
17344.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access through the venue entrance and a further four steps to the bar area. From here, the performance space is down a very steep, narrow flight of 16 stairs. There is no lift access.

There is a mix of unfixed seating during the show.

There is an underground Coles carpark on Little Oxford St as well as street parking out the front of the venue.

138688.name: Central Club Hotel - Depot Bar
138688.accessibilityDetails:
Though the main entrance is not step-free, there is an alternative entrance that has wheelchair access. Please speak to venue staff when you arrive to access this entrance.

The accessible toilets are located near the bottom of the stairs, near the performance space.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show, including tall stools/chairs and booth seating.

139168.name: CERES
139168.address: Corner of Stewart Street & Roberts Street
139168.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue, and ramps throughout the space. Access to outdoor areas is via sloping paths and lightly graveled areas which may require assistance.

There two accessible bathrooms located in the main buildings of the entry courtyard. There is another accessible bathroom in the toilet block alongside the Village Pavilion.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show as well as standing room.

The closest accessible parking bays are approx. 200m from the venue.

139473.name: Chauffeur So Good
139473.accessibilityDetails:
There are two steps into the venue and no alternative wheelchair access. As the venue is an 11 seater tour bus, there is fixed level seating.

The pick up address within metro Melbourne will vary based on the booking. Pick up locations include Federation Square and Russell Court.

142009.name: Cinema Nova
142009.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue, which is located through Lygon Court. The Box Office, Candy Bar and all cinemas except Cinemas 4 and 5 are on Level 1 and can be accessed via either of the two lifts inside Lygon Court; follow signage for wheelchair access.

There are two lifts available. The Woolworths lift provides access from the Woolworths entrance off Drummond Street and the underground carpark to Level 1 of the venue. There is another lift on at the rear of Lygon Court, which offers access from the underground carpark to the Ground Floor and Level 1.

There is fixed raked cinema-style seating during the show. All cinemas are fitted with a loop receiver device, which is suitable for a T switch.

17813.name: City Library - Majorca Room
17813.accessibilityDetails:
There are stairs as well as lift access to enter the performance space from the foyer.

There is unfixed level seating during the show.

149879.name: City Square
149879.address: Swanston Street, between Collins Street & Flinders Lane

3160.name: Club Voltaire
3160.accessibilityDetails:
There are cobblestones and uneven surfaces on the approach to the venue and two steps from the street through the venue entrance. There are two flights of stairs with a landing in between (approx 27 steps) into the performance space. There is no lift access or accessible bathrooms.

There is unfixed level seating during the show.

There is on-street parking available surrounding Raglan Street. There are accessible parking spaces on the corner of Errol & Victoria Streets, Errol Street outside the North Melbourne Library, and the corner of Queensberry & Leveson Streets.

138385.name: Coates Community Arts
138385.accessibilityDetails:
The performance space is located on the fourth floor of the venue and can be reached via lifts. Though there is wheelchair access during office hours, the automatic sliding doors at the main entrance do not function on weekends and evenings after 5.45pm. There is a manual door to the left that is 70cm wide which may not be suitable for some wheelchair users.

There is level unfixed/flexible seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are on Collins St and Spring St.\

16991.name: CoConspirators
16991.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access throughout the venue, including the main entrance. The accessible bathroom is on the ground floor at the rear.

There is a mix of unfixed level seating, including tall stools/chairs and standing room.

There is on-street accessible parking at the front of the venue.

18172.name: Comedy Republic
18172.accessibilityDetails:
There are 22 steps from the entrance of the venue to the bar and a further 25 steps to the performance space. There is no lift access available.

There are no accessible bathrooms.

There are accessible parking spaces along Russell Street, near the corner of Russell and Bourke Streets.

3184.name: Comedy Theatre
3184.accessibilityDetails:
Wheelchair access is available from the main entrance, though venue staff will need to assist by placing a ramp. From here, there is step-free access.

There is an accessible toilet on the ground floor to the right-hand side, opposite Door 4 of the auditorium entrance.

Assistive Listening Packs are available from the cloakroom, including a hearing pack used with T-switch/T-coil hearing aids or cochlear implants, a hearing pack used with a headset, and smartphones used with Bluetooth hearing aids or cochlear implants. You may also use the ListenWiFi app.

There are two accessible parking bays with two hour time limits at 168 Exhibition St, another two with three hour time limits on Little Bourke St (off Spring St), and one further bay at 131 Lonsdale St with a two hour time limit.

For accessible bookings, please contact the venue directly. Further accessibility information for the venue can be found at here.

139047.name: East Melbourne Library
139047.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue. From here, there is lift access to the performance space on the second floor.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

17278.name: Elephant and Wheelbarrow
17278.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access from the street into the venue. There is lift access from the ground floor to the performance space. The lift is straight ahead of you as you head into the venue.

The accessible bathrooms are located on the ground floor but there is a separate entrance to reach them; you will need to head outside the venue and around to the side.

There is unfixed level seating during the show.

There are accessible parking spots on Bourke Street, in between Exhibition Street and Spring Street.

3234.name: Ellora
3234.accessibilityDetails:
There are 20 stairs to reach the performance space. There is no lift access or accessible bathrooms.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show, including tall stools and chairs.

The closest accessible parking bays are on Fitzroy Street.

17903.name: Elsternwick Classic Cinema
17903.accessibilityDetails:
The ground floor has step-free access via a ramp. From here, there is lift access to all levels of the venue. There is fixed raked seating during the show.

The accessible bathrooms are located downstairs near the candy bar.

On-street parking is available nearby.

23657.name: Explosives Factory
23657.accessibilityDetails:
There is one flight of 30 stairs leading into the foyer, as well as a further set of steps to reach the performance space. There is no lift access available.

There is unfixed/flexible raked seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking is on St Kilda Road or Inkerman St.

There is pre-recorded audio description set up in the venue.

For more information please visit the venue website.

31956.name: Fed Square Main Stage
31956.accessibilityDetails: The undulating surface of the Main Square is made up of sandstone cobblestones, with a marked access path. Swanston Street offers the best access to the Main Square, and lift access is available to and from The Atrium. The Big Screen is equipped with a hearing loop and there are accessible toilets located next to Time Out Café. More information regarding accessibility at Federation Square can be found here.

17312.name: fortyfivedownstairs
17312.accessibilityDetails:
The main entrance has four flights of descending stairs (approx 50 steps) to reach the theatre.

Wheelchair access is through the stage door entrance via Spark Lane off Flinders Street. Please note that Sparks Lane is cobblestoned and may be difficult to navigate for visitors using mobility aids. Please ring the bell to notify front of house of your presence. 

For accessible bookings please call the Festival's Box Office on (03) 9245 3788.

138431.name: Frankston Arts Centre
138431.accessibilityDetails: Unassisted wheelchair access is permanently available from the main entrance to the venue.

139158.name: Geelong Arts Centre - The Play House
139158.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue.

There is fixed raked seating during the show. An Audio Induction loop is available in the Stalls from rows F - K. Portable induction loops are also available for use. Please book these with the venue on 1300 251 200.

Accessible parking is available nearby.

17013.name: George Wood Performing Arts Centre
17013.address: Yarra Valley Grammar, Gate A, 84-90 Kalinda Road
17013.accessibilityDetails:
Throughout construction works, wheelchair access is provided from limited disabled parking spaces located outside the north foyer. Wheelchair access continues to remain throughout both foyer spaces and the front stalls.

​​Hearing impaired audience members may make use of the auditorium's Roger hearing system. Contact the venue prior to the event for more information.

17169.name: Golden Gate Hotel
17169.accessibilityDetails:
There is one step into the venue and three flights (24 steps) up to the performance space. There is no alternative wheelchair access. 

There is a mix of unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are in the Clarendon Shopping Centre carpark.

17889.name: Good Heavens Rooftop
17889.accessibilityDetails:
There are two flights of 20 stairs to the performance space, with no lift access. There is unfixed level seating during the show.

The accessible bathrooms are located on the rooftop.

148034.name: Grouse Backyard
148034.accessibilityDetails:
Though the main entrance is not wheelchair accessible, there is an alternative side entrance via Webb Street. Venue staff will need to assist by placing a ramp over the single step at the door.

The bathrooms, whilst size-able, are not fully accessible and depend on access requirements. There is an accessible toilet located 130m from the venue at 112 Smith St.

There is a mix of flexible unfixed level seating during the show. The width of space for wheelchairs via all access points is 80cm.

There are two four-hour accessible parking bays directly outside the venue on Webb Street.

17937.name: Grouse Room 7
17937.accessibilityDetails:
Though the main entrance is not wheelchair accessible, there is an alternative side entrance via Webb Street. Venue staff will need to assist by placing a ramp over the single step at the door.

The bathrooms, whilst size-able, are not fully accessible and depend on access requirements. There is an accessible toilet located 130m from the venue at 112 Smith St.

There is a mix of flexible unfixed level seating during the show. The width of space for wheelchairs via all access points is 80cm.

There are two four-hour accessible parking bays directly outside the venue on Webb Street.

16984.name: Hofbräuhaus Melbourne
16984.accessibilityDetails:
The venue entrance is on street level, with approx. 30 steps leading into the performance space. There is no step free or wheelchair access, and no accessible bathrooms.

The venue has unfixed/flexible level seating and low lighting.

There is on street parking nearby as well as Wilson Parking on Russell Street.

138687.name: House of Maximon
138687.accessibilityDetails:
There is one step through the venue entrance and a further 19 steps to get to the performance space on the first floor. There is no alternative wheelchair access.

There is a mix of unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are located on Russell St.

138678.name: Howler
138678.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue.

The accessible toilets are located on the ground floor, past the main bar and on your right as you head towards the theatre.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show, as well as booth seating at the back of the room. There may also be cabaret seating with tables and standing room, depending on the show.

There is a carpark outside the venue that has accessible parking bays.

16982.name: Impro Melbourne Theatre
16982.accessibilityDetails:
The front entrance of the venue is wheelchair accessible, though audiences are generally directed to the rear entrance for performances. If you require wheelchair access, please call the venue in advance on 03 9416 2555. There are no accessible bathrooms.

There is a mix of level and raked unfixed/flexible seating and average lighting (similar to theatres or restaurants).

17381.name: Ivanhoe Library and Cultural Hub - Yarra-Me Djil-theatrette
17381.accessibilityDetails:
The main entrance is wheelchair accessible, though venue staff may need to assist. There is lift access to the lower platform of the performance space and fixed raked seating during the show.

The accessible bathrooms are directly across the hall from the main theatre entrance.

There is fixed raked seating during the show and a hearing loop is available.

Accessible parking can be found adjacent to the carpark. There is also on-street parking nearby.

141496.name: JOLTED Arts Space - Theatre
141496.accessibilityDetails:
The main entrance is not wheelchair accessible. Step free entry is via the ramps from the carpark at the rear of the building. Please contact the venue if you require wheelchair access.

There is a mix of unfixed chairs, cabaret seating with tables, and standing room during the show.

The accessible bathrooms are on the ground floor of the venue.

3201.name: Kicks
3201.accessibilityDetails:
The venue is on the first floor of the building. Lift access is available to reach the performance space. Some areas are quite narrow so navigating a larger wheelchair may be challenging.

There is unfixed level seating during the show.

Secure Parking is located nearby at 440 Elizabeth Street. There is also on street accessible parking nearby on A'Beckett Street.

17021.name: Kindred Studios
17021.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access into the venue using ramps. The accessible bathrooms are on the ground floor, past the cafe under the steps.

The seating layout may change depending on the show, and floor is a mix of leveled and raked. There is low lighting at this venue.

There are accessible parking bays just outside the main entrance.

13848.name: Kingston Arts Centre
13848.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance on the ground floor, and lift access to the theatre on Level 1.

The accessible bathrooms are located on the ground floor.

Assistive listening is available via a T-Switch hearing loop. Please contact the venue on 03 9556 4440 for more information.

There is fixed raked seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are in the carpark underneath the building.

17898.name: Library at the Dock - Performance Space
17898.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access through the main entrance of the venue, and ramps and lifts to the different spaces one inside.

There are accessible bathrooms on each floor, including the same floor as the performance space.

There is a mix of unfixed and fixed seating during the show. Assisted Listening is available via portable IR devices. Please speak to venue staff on arrival if you would like to use this service.

Nearby parking is limited, though there are two accessible parking bays in the lane next to the venue.

17808.name: Lido Cinemas
17808.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access via a lift to reach the performance space. When entering from Glenferrie Road, turn right to find the lift at the end of the corridor.

There is fixed raked seating during the show.

The accessible bathrooms are located in the lobby next to the lift on both the foyer and cinema levels.

Accessible parking can be found behind the venue.

17170.name: Limerick Arms
17170.accessibilityDetails:
There are 15 steps to reach the venue and no wheelchair access. The accessible bathrooms are located downstairs.

There is unfixed level seating during the show.

16990.name: Mamao Club - Bourke Street
16990.accessibilityDetails:
There is one step at the front entrance of the venue and 50 steps leading to the performance space. There are 6 steps to lift access. The venue has no accessible bathrooms.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating and low lighting during the show.

First Parking is available nearby.

3127.name: Max Watt's
3127.accessibilityDetails:
This is a basement venue off Swanston Street, directly across the road from the Melbourne Town Hall. It can be accessed by a staircase of approx. 25+ stairs, which services both levels, with landings at several points. The staircase has both left and right handrails for the length of the staircase.

Whilst there is a service lift that can be used to access the main theatre and mezzanine levels, it is not considered step free or wheelchair accessible as a result of historic architecture and seating arrangement. Please speak to security or a member of staff if you require the use of the service lift.

For more information, please visit our FMV accessibility page.

17902.name: McKinnon Hotel
17902.accessibilityDetails:
There is lift access available to the performance space.

There is a mix of unfixed level seating during the show, including tall stools/chairs and standing room.

The venue carpark has designated accessible parking bays.

139166.name: Meeting Point: Corner of La Trobe & Russell Street
139166.address: Corner of La Trobe St & Russell St
139166.accessibilityDetails:
This event starts on the north east corner of La Trobe & Russell St. The walking tour takes place around the Melbourne CBD. Due to varying surfaces on parts of the route, it is not guaranteed that the show is fully wheelchair accessible.

There is on-street parking available near the meeting point.

138613.name: Meeting Point: Corner Swanston Street & Collins Street
138613.address: Corner of Swanston Street & Collins Street
138613.accessibilityDetails: Meet outside Melbourne Town Hall, on the corner of Swanston St and Collins. There is step-free access for the duration of the show, however there will be approx 1.2km of walking.

139167.name: Meeting Point: Outside Northern Soul
139167.accessibilityDetails:
This event takes place around St Kilda. Due to varying surfaces on parts of the route, it is not guaranteed that the show is fully wheelchair accessible.

There is on-street parking available near the meeting point.

143894.name: Melb City Comedy HUB - Curate Space
143894.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue via glass doors. The accessible bathrooms are located on the same floor as the performance space.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

Accessible parking is located in Wilsons Parking at 131 Elizabeth Street, approx 4 minutes from the venue.

17557.name: Melbourne Museum - Theatre
17557.accessibilityDetails:
Entry to the venue foyer is from the plaza between Melbourne Museum and the Royal Exhibition Building.

The performance space is on the lower ground level and can be accessed via a lift or escalator from the foyer. If using the escalator, turn right as you reach the bottom and the door is on the left-hand side of the corridor.

Accessible seating is available on the right-hand side and the left-hand-side of the performance space, midway in the room (approx. halfway up the raked seating).

For more information, please visit our FMV accessibility page.

143117.name: MEMO Music Hall
143117.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue. The accessible toilets are located near the performance space.

There is unfixed/flexible raked seating during the show, including tall stools/chairs, cabaret seating with tables, and standing room.

There is ticketed street parking available nearby.

138747.name: Miscellania
138747.accessibilityDetails:
There are two flights of 20 stairs to enter the venue and no alternative wheelchair access.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show as well as standing room.

The closest accessible parking bays are in QV.

138541.name: Old Treasury Building
138541.accessibilityDetails:
There is a staircase at the main entrance of the venue. Alternatively, there is a wheelchair accessible entrance off Treasury Place, at the rear of the building, which takes you to the basement level. Please press the intercom when you arrive and venue staff will open the door from the inside.

There is lift access to all floors of the building, which fits most mobility scooters. The lift entrance is 89cm wide, and the internal measurements are 95 x 172cm.

The accessible bathrooms are located in the basement which is accessible via the lift.

There is a mix of unfixed level seating during the show as well as standing room. Some walking tours may also meet here, depending on the show.

There are two accessible parking spaces on Spring St, opposite the venue.

For more information, please visit the venue website.

3153.name: Palais Theatre
3153.accessibilityDetails:
VENUE ENTRY
Entry into the venue foyer is via the Lower Esplanade main entrance doors. All entry doors provide accessible entry. There are no steps from the footpath outside the Venue to the front of the Ground Level auditorium.

STALLS ENTRY
Entry into the Stalls auditorium provides access to accessible seating in Stalls Rows A & W plus access to the Lift and Accessible toilet.  

LEVEL 1 ACCESS
Lift access is available to Level 1 foyer area, providing access to bars, Lounge Row D accessible seating and an accessible toilet.

A Social Story for the Palais Theatre can be found here.

139161.name: Piano on Swan
139161.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue.

There is a mix of unfixed/flexible level seating during the show, including tall stools/chairs and cabaret seating with tables.

There is street parking on Swanston St and in the surrounding area.

3273.name: Plenty Ranges Arts & Convention Centre
3273.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access available from the main entrance to the venue. There are two accessible toilets on the ground floor, either side of the foyer, located near the male and female toilets.

A hearing loop is available and receiver devices can be provided. There is fixed raked seating during the show.

There are two accessible parking bays at the front of the venue.

To book accessible seating, please contact the venue directly on 03 9217 2317.

138755.name: Pulp
138755.accessibilityDetails:
There is one step into the venue and no alternative wheelchair access.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are nearby on Russell St.

138216.name: Regent Theatre
138216.accessibilityDetails:
Step-free access is via the Box Restaurant next door to the theatre. Venue staff need to assist. From here, there wheelchair access is via a lift.

The accessible bathroom is in the stalls foyer, on the same level as the lift. Head through the doors towards the merchandise stand and the accessible toilet will be on your left.

Assistive Listening Packs are available from the cloakroom, including a hearing pack used with T-switch/T-coil hearing aids or cochlear implants, a hearing pack used with a headset, and smartphones used with Bluetooth hearing aids or cochlear implants. You may also use the ListenWiFi app.
The closest accessible parking bays are on Collins St near the Melbourne Town Hall, on Russell St between Flinders Lane and Collins St, and at Wilson Parking at 161 Collins St.

For accessible bookings, please contact the venue directly. Further accessibility information for the venue can be found at here.

17028.name: Roxy's Bar
17028.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access through the main entrance on the ground floor and unassisted wheelchair access through the double doors.

The accessible bathrooms are located in the main area of the venue.

There is a mix of unfixed level seating, including tall stools/chairs, as well as standing room during the show.

17029.name: Spleen Bar
17029.accessibilityDetails:
There is one step into the venue and no accessible bathrooms. Wheelchair access is possible beyond this, though the bar is narrow. We recommend contacting the venue in advance on 03 9650 2400 if you require wheelchair access.

There is a mix of unfixed level seating, including tall stools/chairs.

17284.name: St Kilda Cellars
17284.accessibilityDetails:
There is level access throughout the venue, with two slight, wheelchair-friendly inclines. 

The accessible toilets are located past the bar and shelves, before the entrance to the performance space on the left.

There is a mix of unfixed/flexible level seating during the show, as well as standing room.

Accessible parking can be found on Jackson Street. Head down Fitzroy Street towards St Kilda Beach, turn left at the 7-Eleven and then turn right.

149878.name: State Library Victoria
149878.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue via a ramp on La Trobe St. A courtesy wheelchair is available upon request.

Accessible toilets are available in the Swanston Street Welcome Zone near Mr Tulk, Gateway Level 2 near the lifts, the Russell Street Welcome Zone via Entry 5 on La Trobe Street, and The Ian Potter Queen’s Hall. The Children’s Quarter on Level 2 also has joint accessible facilities for carers and children.

A hearing loop is available upon request. There is fixed level seating during the show.

There are accessible street parking spaces on La Trobe St, Little Lonsdale St and Russell St.

3202.name: Storyville Melbourne
3202.accessibilityDetails:
Entry to the venue is via Waratah Place. This venue is on the second floor of the building and there are three stairwells up to the theatre space. There is no lift.

There is unfixed level seating and low lighting at this venue.

3135.name: Swiss Club
3135.accessibilityDetails:
The performance space is on the second floor of the venue. There are six steps to the first-floor landing, and a further 20 stairs with landings at several points to the second floor. The staircase is timber and has both left and right handrails.

Whilst there is a passenger lift from the first-floor landing, it is not considered step-free or wheelchair accessible. NB: The passenger lift is currently out of order.

Bathrooms are available at the rear of the performance space and are only accessible once the house is open. There are no wheelchair accessible bathrooms.

For more information, please visit our FMV accessibility page.

139477.name: Tallboy and Moose
139477.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue.

There is a mix of unfixed/flexible level seating during the show including tall stools/chairs, cabaret seating with tables, and standing room.

Street parking is available nearby.

3123.name: The Capitol
3123.accessibilityDetails:
Entry to the venue is from Swanston Street via the Capitol Arcade and up approx. 20 stairs with handrails on either side into the venue foyer. The venue seating is raked, so there is additional steps to allocated seat.

For step-free access, there is a lift approx 30m into the arcade which takes you to the venue's foyer level. From here, a separate lift provides access to the Theatre, Salon and Lounge Levels.

There are two types of assisted listening available.

For more information, please visit our FMV accessibility page.

17032.name: The Catfish
17032.accessibilityDetails:
There are 15 stairs into the venue and no wheelchair access.

There is a mix of unfixed level seating, including tall stools/chairs and booth seating, during the show.

Street parking is available nearby, as well as stops on the 86, 96, and 11 tram lines.

3216.name: The Charles Dickens Tavern
3216.accessibilityDetails:
The main entrance to the venue is through an arcade with level access and down a flight of stairs. There is lift access next to stairs, though the lift entrance is approx 70cm wide and approx 1.3m deep once inside. If the lift door is not open when you arrive, please contact the venue on 03 9654 1821.

There is step free access to the female toilets once inside the venue. There are three steps to access the male toilets.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are on Collins St.

3139.name: The Comic's Lounge
3139.accessibilityDetails:
There are 35 steps into the venue with no wheelchair access.

There is unfixed level seating during the show, including cabaret seating with tables.

17045.name: The Grace Darling Hotel
17045.accessibilityDetails:
There is step free access at the entrance of the venue, but once inside the venue there are 16 steps to access all performance spaces. There is no lift access available to any performance spaces, and no accessible bathrooms.

There is unfixed level seating and standing room during the show.

There is accessible parking available adjacent to the venue.

17160.name: The Greek
17160.accessibilityDetails: Unassisted wheelchair access is permanently available from the main entrance. There is lift access to each level of the venue, and accessible toilets on each floor.

3168.name: The Improv Conspiracy Theatre
3168.accessibilityDetails:
There are approx 20 stairs from the street to the main bar area, and level access from the bar to the performance space.

There are no accessible bathrooms; there are 5 steps from the main bar area to the bathrooms.

There is unfixed level seating during the show.

Secure carpark is directly behind the venue and has accessible parking spots.

For any further questions regarding accessibility, please email the venue directly.

138795.name: The Laneway Theatre
138795.accessibilityDetails:
Wheelchair access can be arranged from an alternative entrance. Please contact the venue at the time of booking if you require access.

The accessible toilets are located on the ground floor.

There is fixed raked seating during the show.

Street parking is available nearby.

3183.name: The Local Taphouse
3183.accessibilityDetails:
The front door to the venue swings outwards. Please speak to venue staff if you need assistance with entry. There is level access throughout the space and a mix of unfixed level seating during the show, including tall stools/chairs.

The accessible bathrooms are located off the corridor, past the main room downstairs. 

Accessible parking is approx half a block away, outside St Kilda Library. The best drop off area is near the pedestrian crossing on the corner of Carlisle and Chapel Street.

The nearest train station is Balaclava on the Sandringham line which is ramp accessible. Footpaths to venue are in decent condition and with no cobblestones.

3194.name: The MC Showroom
3194.accessibilityDetails:
There are 25 steps (including two landings) and handrails on both sides from the street to the foyer, with no lift access.

There is unfixed raked seating and cabaret style seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are in Care Park on Park Street.

139165.name: The Motley Spielhaus
139165.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

3185.name: The National Theatre
3185.accessibilityDetails:
The front entrance has level access but may require directional assistance from venue staff. From here, there are two steps to the auditorium and lift access to the mezzanine, plus 20 steps to reach the performance space.

There is a hearing loop available to tune into the frequency of the venue, and fixed raked allocated seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bay is behind the bus stop on the north side of Barkly Street. Street parking is also available nearby.

For more information, please contact the venue on 03 9525 4611.

17901.name: The Old Courthouse Theatre
17901.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access available through the main entrance via a ramp, as well as lift access to the performance space on Level 1. There is fixed raked seating during the show, with accessible seating in the front row.

The accessible bathrooms are located on the ground floor and first floor of the building.

Accessible parking is available across the street from the venue, as well as in the City Carpark nearby.

138832.name: The Round - Theatre
138832.accessibilityDetails:
There is level wheelchair access from the carpark to the performance space. The accessible bathrooms are in the ground floor foyer, on both east and west sides of the building, as well as a changing facility.

This venue has assistive listening. There is a Hearing Augmentation System that includes a Listen Technologies system with 24 receivers. Hearing Aid users can use a T-switch.

There is fixed raked seating during the show.

There are 8 accessible parking bays close to the front entrance.

For more information, please visit the venue website.

3230.name: The Stone Hotel
3230.accessibilityDetails:
There are 20 steps leading up to the venue, and no wheelchair access.

There is unfixed/flexible level seating during the show.

The closest accessible parking bays are on Brunswick Street.

3195.name: The Thornbury Theatre
3195.accessibilityDetails:
There is unassisted wheelchair access through the main entrance of the venue. From here, there is lift access and a ramp to the performance space on Level 1.

The accessible toilets are located on the Ground Floor. 

The venue has multiple show setups available to select from, including cabaret table seating, theatre style seating, or standing shows. 

Accessible parking can be found on High Street.

3159.name: The Toff in Town
3159.accessibilityDetails:
The main entrance is wheelchair accessible. There is an lift that can be used to reach the venue on Level 2. Venue staff can deploy a ramp for ease of access to the bar for wheelchair users. Please contact the venue in advance to arrange this.

The bathrooms on Level 2 have a step up and no wheelchair access. Please speak to venue staff for more information as access can be arranged with staff assistance.

There is a mix of unfixed level seating including tall stools/chairs, couches, etc during the show.

There is accessible parking available for permit holders in the surrounding area, though not immediately adjacent or attached to the venue.

138756.name: The Tote
138756.accessibilityDetails:
There are 21 steps to enter the venue and no alternative wheelchair access.

This venue has standing room only during the show.

There is street parking available nearby on Wellington St.

17050.name: Wheat, Wine & Whisky
17050.accessibilityDetails:
There are 17 steps to the main entrance of the venue. No step free access is available.

There are accessible bathrooms on each level of the venue.

There is a mix of unfixed seating during the show, including tall stools/chairs, booths, and standing room.

There is on-street parking outside the venue and in surrounding streets.

shows.showName: A Beginner's Guide to Ancient Egypt

venue.name: Storyville Melbourne
venue.accessibilityDetails:
Entry to the venue is via Waratah Place. This venue is on the second floor of the building and there are three stairwells up to the theatre space. There is no lift.

There is unfixed level seating and low lighting at this venue.
